name: set_blocks
title: world.set_blocks
lead: Sets many blocks at once, live, stored and sent; the cheapest way. A row takes `skin` too, for a player head.
signature: world.set_blocks(changes: { { at: Vec3, block: BlockRef, skin: HeadSkin ? } })

params.name: changes
params.type: { { at: Vec3 , block: BlockRef , skin: HeadSkin ? } }

usedIn.quote: world.set_blocks({ { at = vec3(...), block = "red_wool" }, ... })   -- many at once, cheapest; a row takes skin = too
